meta.landingTitle: Evidomo: listing packs where every claim has a source
meta.landingDescription: Photos and a voice walkthrough in, a listing pack out. Every statement links to the form field, spoken turn, or photo it came from, and you review it before export.

hero.lede: Walk the property, talk, and take photos. Evidomo drafts the listing pack and shows where each statement came from, so you approve facts, not guesses.
hero.footnote: Open any sentence of a pack to see the form field, the spoken turn, or the part of the photo it rests on.
hero.caption: An illustrative example, not a real listing. Each numbered note names the source of a claim.

how.title: From a walk-through to a pack you can defend
how.subtitle: Three steps, and you stay in control of the second.
how.packPreviewLabel: Example of a listing pack: two statements, each with its source

capture.title: Capture
capture.text: Photograph each room, record a voice walkthrough in your own language, and confirm the facts you know. It works on a phone, at the property.

verify.title: Verify
verify.text: Where the form, the voice, and the photos disagree, the run stops and you decide. Every sentence of the draft links to the evidence behind it.

pack.title: Pack
pack.text: Download a print-ready pack: listing text for portals and social, buyer Q&A cards, and structured portal fields. Each claim stays traceable.

evidence.title: Every claim has a source
evidence.text: Open any sentence of a listing pack and see the form field, the spoken turn, or the part of the photo it rests on. A claim without evidence is flagged for your decision before export.
evidence.caption: An illustrative example, not a real listing. Highlighted phrases are claims with evidence.
evidence.notesLabel: Example evidence for the highlighted claims
evidence.sentence: A bright <c1>living room of 38 m²</c1> with an <c2>oak herringbone floor</c2> and a <c3>garden facing south</c3>.

floor.region: The region is outlined on the photo.

garden.quote: “The garden faces south, it gets sun until late.”

calls.title: You make the calls
calls.text: Two reviews put you in charge: conflicting facts first, then every flagged sentence and staged image. The run waits for you.

staging.title: Staging is labelled
staging.text: A virtually staged image is labelled as such and always shown next to the original.

private.title: Private details are removed
private.text: Photo metadata, including GPS, is stripped at upload. Faces and license plates are blurred in exports.

assists.title: It assists, it does not certify
assists.text: The publication checklist helps you spot missing items. Evidomo does not certify legal compliance, value a property, or publish to portals for you.

cta.title: Ready for your next listing?
cta.text: Add photos and a voice walkthrough, then review the draft before anything leaves.

images.interior2: A limewashed brick fireplace with an oak mantel, eucalyptus in a terracotta pot, and birch logs

intake.label: Reading the walkthrough
intake.description: Turning your voice memo into a transcript, one speaker turn at a time.

fact_extraction.label: Picking out the facts
fact_extraction.description: Pulling facts from the transcript and your form, each tied to where it came from.

vision_inventory.label: Looking at the photos
vision_inventory.description: Checking each photo for rooms, fittings, and condition.

reconciliation.label: Comparing the facts
reconciliation.description: Finding facts that disagree between the form, the voice, and the photos.

creative.label: Writing the listing
creative.description: Drafting the portal text and the social caption from the confirmed facts.

qa_cards.label: Preparing buyer questions
qa_cards.description: Answering the questions buyers usually ask, from the same facts.

staging.label: Staging the photos
staging.description: Producing furnished versions of empty rooms, always labelled as staged.

integrity.label: Checking the staged photos
integrity.description: Making sure staging changed no windows, doors, or other fixed elements.

verification.label: Checking every claim
verification.description: Testing each sentence against the facts it cites.

export.label: Building the pack
export.description: Assembling the HTML pack, the portal fields, and the images.
